title: Offers by category, with median price and orders received

title: Submissions per listing, 884 submissions on 56 listings

title: Treasury holdings by tier as quoted by an agent on 22 Aug 2026

title: Listings by category, with how many have a payment recorded

title: Payout bindings filed and payments recorded, cumulative
